# Nestbolt

> Free, open-source nesting for people who cut fixed sheets: laser cutters, CNC routers, plasma, waterjet, fabric and leather. Nestbolt arranges parts so they use the least material. It runs in your browser (nothing is uploaded), on the command line, and as an MCP server that AI agents can call.

## App

- [Browser app](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/): nest locally in the current preview build from main; files never leave your computer.

## Guides

- [Free nesting for laser cutting](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/free-nesting-software-laser-cutting/): sheet settings, browser workflow, exports and limitations for cutting jobs.
- [Nestbolt vs Deepnest and SVGnest](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/deepnest-alternative/): the frozen comparison with Deepnest, SVGnest and Sparrow, including where Sparrow wins.
- [Nest SVG and DXF in the browser](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/nest-svg-dxf-in-browser/): private local import, geometry review, spacing, rotations and export.

## Examples

- [Five bundled examples](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/nesting-examples/): drawing summaries, exact settings, source credits and instructions for trying each job.
- [Finger-jointed boxes](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/nesting-examples/finger-jointed-boxes/): two 99 × 63 × 45 mm finger-jointed boxes, 12 panels, on a 400 × 300 mm laser bed.
- [Letters inside letters](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/nesting-examples/letters-inside-letters/): 147 glyphs in four sizes; small ones nest inside the holes of large ones.
- [Mechanical parts kit](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/nesting-examples/mechanical-parts-kit/): 138 brackets, cogs, frames and inserts on a 1220 × 2440 mm plywood sheet; inserts go in the frames.
- [Sewing pattern on a fabric roll](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/nesting-examples/sewing-pattern-fabric-roll/): Ten FreeSewing T-shirts (40 pieces) on a 1500 mm fabric roll; grain keeps pieces at 0° or 180°.
- [Interlocking gears](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/nesting-examples/interlocking-gears/): 40 gears in two sizes with free rotation, so teeth can mesh, on a 300 × 200 mm bed.

## Benchmark results

- [Results](https://skulitom.github.io/Nestbolt/results/): every per-job number, tool revision, seed and hardware for the frozen benchmark.

## GitHub documentation

- [README](https://github.com/skulitom/Nestbolt/blob/main/README.md): features, quick start, browser app and release downloads.
- [Agent interface](https://github.com/skulitom/Nestbolt/blob/main/docs/AGENT_INTERFACE.md): MCP tools, request format, workspace rules and agent setup.
- [Importing](https://github.com/skulitom/Nestbolt/blob/main/docs/IMPORTING.md): geometry, units, cutting layers, explicit repairs and import reports.
- [Status](https://github.com/skulitom/Nestbolt/blob/main/docs/STATUS.md): completed milestones, supporting evidence and remaining work.
- [Benchmarks](https://github.com/skulitom/Nestbolt/blob/main/BENCHMARKS.md): every benchmark run, including failures.
